svg.aria-label: General note: I turn sprawling infrastructure into calm, automated systems — the boring kind of reliability, the kind nobody notices because nothing breaks. My work centers on migrating services into containerized environments, GitOps automation and observability. I also build with Python, and I've led and mentored engineering teams along the way. Bill of materials: Cloud: AWS, EC2, S3, EKS, IAM, Lambda, RDS, GCP; Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, k3s, Rancher, ECS; Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, AppDynamics; CI/CD & GitOps: Argo CD, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines; Automation & IaC: Terraform, Ansible, SOPS + AGE; Languages: Python, Bash, Java; Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL
